meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: S-adenosylmethionine, the cell's methyl-donor currency, binds SAMTOR and pulls it off GATOR1 - this is how methionine availability reaches mTORC1.
data.mechanism_beginner: SAM, a byproduct of methionine, binds SAMTOR and pulls it away from GATOR1 – the proposed way the cell senses how much methionine it has. Worked out in cells; whether this sensor is what matters in a whole animal has not been shown.
data.boundary: Single-study edge. Needs independent replication before it is treated as established.
data.note: Only one supporting study in the corpus - flag as thin.
